Oncology
Cancer staging and diagnostics
You will meet with an Oncologist for your first consultation to go over all of the options available.
Learn More →
Electrochemotherapy
Electrochemotherapy is an anti-cancer treatment that couples local administration of chemotherapy drugs to the delivery of pulses of a specific waveform.
Learn More →
Oral Chemotherapy
With some cancers, oral strategies of chemotherapy are great choices and make more sense.
Learn More →
Injectable Chemotherapy
Chemotherapy works by targeting rapidly dividing cells.
Learn More →
Immunotherapy
The immune system plays an important role in identifying and killing cancer cells in the body.
Learn More →
Radiation Therapy
Radiation therapy can be used alone or in combination with surgery and/or chemotherapy to provide long term control or death of a tumor.
Learn More →
Stereotactic radiation therapy (SRT) and Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT)
Stereotactic radiation (SRT) and Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT) allows for directed radiation therapy to difficult areas to treat.
Learn More →
Half Body Radiation therapy
This therapy is a consolidation therapy for lymphoma in dogs.
Learn More →
Ultrasound
Ultrasound can help us visualize the abdominal organs, the neck, external masses and even masses within the chest.
Learn More →
Computed Tomography
Technology continues to improve and BARC has one of the premier digital direct radiology (DR) suites.
Learn More →
